publicStateRules.PLANNED: May be described only as planned, without a public schedule unless separately verified.
publicStateRules.LOCATION_RESEARCH: Private research state; not a public event claim.
publicStateRules.OWNER_REVIEW: Private review state; not a public event claim.
publicStateRules.SCHEDULED: May be described as scheduled only with verified location, date, time, responsible person, accessibility, safety, support, and cancellation plan.
publicStateRules.ACTIVE: May be described as active only during the verified operating window with responsible staffing and incident support.
publicStateRules.COMPLETED: May be described as completed only after a dated outcome record.
publicStateRules.CANCELED: Must not remain publicly represented as scheduled or active.
publicStateRules.VERIFIED_LOCATION: Location verification alone does not prove a scheduled or active booth.
publicStateRules.UNVERIFIED: Must not be represented as scheduled, active, or completed.

prohibitedData: precise confidential shelter or service locations
